description:
In Episode 243 we discuss the Third Elijah. The Bible says that in the last days the third Elijah would be the final end time movement preparing the world for Jesus' second coming and that this Elijah will call people back to the obedience of God’s commandments. Revelation tells us that the attributes of this remnant will be that they keep the commandments of God and have the testimony of Jesus. As God sent reforming messages to His people through Elijah and John the Baptist so these messages are to bring  His people back into harmony by restoring Biblical truth before the return of Jesus.
